top_signals.title: Tencent-Backed China Chipmaker Enflame Seeks $911 Million in IPO
top_signals.summary: Shanghai Enflame Technology Co., backed by Tencent Holdings Ltd., is seeking to raise about 6.12 billion yuan ($911 million) in an initial public offering, as the last of the so-called “four little dragons” of leading Chinese artificial intelligence chipmakers taps the public market.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Software companies pay steep price to buy time against AI threat
top_signals.summary: Private equity groups face a $40bn maturity wall in 2028 to refinance Covid-era software buyouts
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
